# Getting help

- **How do I…?** Look in the [README](../README.md) and in
  [Storybook](https://storybook.levuche.com), where every block shows its
  options and code. Still stuck? Ask in
  [Discussions › Q&A](https://github.com/Levuche/ui/discussions).
- **Something is broken?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/Levuche/ui/issues/new/choose).
- **A security problem?** Report it privately, as
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says.
- **An idea?** Share it in
  [Discussions › Ideas](https://github.com/Levuche/ui/discussions), or
  [ask for a block](https://github.com/Levuche/ui/issues/new/choose).

Questions about a Levuche account, a creator's page or billing aren't
answered here; use the help inside the Levuche app.

## Using Discussions

- **Q&A**: questions with an answer. Mark the reply that solved it.
- **Ideas**: blocks and options you'd like, before they're issues.
- **Show and tell**: pages and blocks you've built.
- **Announcements**: new releases and changes (maintainers post here).

Please keep one topic per discussion and search before you post.
